name: Border Beam Button
description: Pill call-to-action with a bright gradient beam that travels around its border at constant speed and accelerates on hover.

name: Shimmer Button
description: Dark AI action button with a sweeping shimmer highlight, twinkling spark and a springy press that throws off sparkles.

name: Radiant Button
description: Gradient-rimmed button whose soft halo and border highlight follow the cursor, orbiting on its own when idle.

name: Magnetic Button
description: Circular “Get started” button that is pulled toward the cursor with spring physics and a parallax label.

name: Save Button
description: Save button that morphs into a spinner and then a drawn check with a “Saved” label.

name: Like Burst Button
description: Heart toggle with a ring and particle burst plus an odometer-style rolling like count.

name: Gooey Switch
description: Settings toggles whose thumbs stretch and merge like liquid thanks to an SVG goo filter.

name: Theme Toggle
description: Sun-to-moon morphing toggle that flips its little stage between light and dark with a circular reveal.

name: Elastic Slider
description: Volume slider that rubber-bands when dragged past either end, with a floating value bubble.

name: OTP Input
description: Six-digit verification code input with an animated caret, auto-advance, paste support and success/error feedback.

name: Expanding Search
description: Search icon that expands into a field with filtered, highlighted suggestions and full keyboard navigation.

name: Stacked Chips
description: Selectable filter chips that reflow with smooth FLIP motion while selections stack into a counted summary.
